mentions.name: Open Bike Computer
mentions.description: An open source bike computer built on ESP32-S3 open source hardware, positioned as an alternative to closed-ecosystem Garmin devices. It connects to Apple Workouts and Maps.
mentions.problem: Commercial bike computers like Garmin are closed-ecosystem devices.
mentions.source_excerpt: An open source bike computer as alternative to closed-ecosystem Garmins. It runs on ESP32-S3 open source hardware, and connects to your Apple Workouts & Maps https://github.com/seichris/open-bike-computer
